newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila approves 97.5 bln pesos worth of projects.
newsitem.headline: Manila approves 97.5 bln pesos worth of projects.

text.p: The Philippines National Economic and Development (Neda) board said on Thursday it had approved 10 projects worth 97.5 billion.

In a statement, the economic planning agency said the projects approved on Tuesday were: the 24.9 billion peso San Roque power plant and dam project, the 18.3 billion peso Light Rail Transit Line 3, the 17.3 billion peso road development project, a 15.2 billion peso Third Elementary Education Project of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports and the 11.8 billion peso rehabilitation and expansion of the 400-megawatt Caliraya-Botocan-Kalayaan power plant of the National Power Corp.

The other projects are the 3.6 billion peso Small Towns Water Supply and Sanitation Project, the 3.02 billion peso five-year Agrarian Reform Community Development Project, an 2.24 billion Leyte-Bohol grid interconnection project, a 764 million peso Mindanao Development Project, and the 169-million peso engineering loan for the Leyte-Mindanao grids.
Neda approval will pave the way for proponents to start firming financing for the projects.
